notes.title: Jan 23rd Trainee Death Simulator Update Log
notes.content:
1、Add Death Dress-up [Greetings for the New Year!].
2、Add new events related to Death Dress-up [Greetings for the New Year!].
3、Fix the bug some events will not be triggered after multiple awakenings.
4、Fix the bug some important Items cannot be obtained under special circumstances.
5、Fix the bug abnormal Soul acquisition due to the superposition of Soul harvesting efficiency.

notes.title: Trainee Death Simulator Update Log V1.1
notes.content:
1.	Update SAVE/LOAD function. 
After the update, there will be one AUTO save slot and two manual save slots. The old save will default to the automatic save slot. Automatic save will be performed once after each resurrection, while manual save can be done at any time.

2.	Optimized the exploration sequence of Black Star Town.
Now only completing the library event can proceed to explore the hidden path

3. Optimized the settlement logic of some events to match the description

4. Fixed the issue of incorrect display of attribute endings

5. . Fixed the issue of abnormal icon display caused by losing other locked attribute props when owning Huangmushroom

6. Optimization and correction of some game texts

notes.title: Trainee Death Simulator Update Log V1.0
notes.content:
1. Add a link to select the game language before starting (no effect on players who have already entered the game).
2. Shorten the red, green and blue mushrooms affecting time, and some certain characters will not be affected.
3. Improve the number of Souls that need to be submitted to the mainline after 3 weekly programs, so that it is convenient for everyone to explore the Endings.
4. Fix the bug of abnormal events.
5. Fix the bug of click area in the main interface was abnormal.
6. Fix the bug of abnormal display of the number of revivals in the news.
7. Optimization and correction of part of the game text.
8. Replace the regular BGM, and we will continue to optimize the music and sound effects.

notes.title: Trainee Death Simulator will be released on November 13th
Demo Hotfix V0.11
notes.content:
The following issues have been fixed:

1. Fix the issue unable to select the "Give Up" option during the debt-doubling event.
2. Fix the issue no notification displayed when unlocking outfits.
3. Fix the issue when wearing the outfit [Day of Humanity] and entering the second playthrough, the initial attributes are reduced to negative values, resulting in immediate death.
4. Fix the issue infinite loops occurring in special events such as the Hoshino's Shop and Lake Bathing.
5. Fix the issue starting the second playthrough immediately after reaching an ending does not complete the tasks.
6. Fix the issue certain in-game sound effects cannot be adjusted through the Settings.
